message: actions/checkout@v1-v4 runs on Node 20. Node 20 is removed from GitHub-hosted runners on 2026-09-23 - move to actions/checkout@v5 (needs runner 2.327.1 or later).
actions/setup-node@v1-v4 runs on Node 20, removed from the runner on 2026-09-23 - move to actions/setup-node@v5.
artifact actions v3 were shut down on 2025-01-30 - the step fails today. Move to v6 (v4 changed to immutable artifacts, so a job that uploaded the same name twice needs merge-multiple).
artifact actions v4 and v5 still default to Node 20, which the runner drops on 2026-09-23 - move to v6 (needs runner 2.327.1 or later).
actions/cache@v1 and @v2 stopped working on 2025-02-01, and the v1 cache service was shut down on 2025-04-15 - move to actions/cache@v5.
actions/cache@v3-v4 runs on Node 20, removed from the runner on 2026-09-23 - move to actions/cache@v5, which uses the rewritten cache service.
actions/setup-python@v1-v5 runs on Node 20, removed from the runner on 2026-09-23 - move to actions/setup-python@v6.
actions/setup-java@v1-v4 is deprecated and runs on Node 20, removed from the runner on 2026-09-23 - move to actions/setup-java@v6.
the ubuntu-18.04 runner image was removed on 2022-12-01 - the job cannot start. Use ubuntu-24.04.
the ubuntu-20.04 runner image became fully unsupported on 2025-04-15 - the job fails to start. Use ubuntu-24.04.
ubuntu-22.04 and ubuntu-22.04-arm enter deprecation on 2026-09-17 and are fully unsupported on 2027-04-17 - move to ubuntu-24.04 or ubuntu-26.04 before the brownouts start.
the windows-2019 runner image became fully unsupported on 2025-06-30 - the job fails to start. Use windows-2022 or windows-2025.
macos-11 was removed on 2024-06-28 and macos-12 on 2024-12-03 - the job cannot start. Use macos-15, or macos-15-intel if the build needs x86_64.
the macos-13 runner image was retired on 2025-12-04 - the job cannot start. Use macos-15 (arm64) or macos-15-intel for x86_64 builds.
macos-latest is arm64. An x86_64-only build silently needs macos-15-intel or a -large label, and GitHub drops x86_64 macOS after the macos-15 image retires in autumn 2027.

ubuntu-latest resolves to ubuntu-24.04 today and moves without notice when GitHub promotes the next LTS (ubuntu-26.04 labels already exist). Pin the version if the build depends on the image contents.
the ::set-output workflow command was disabled on 2023-06-01 and is now ignored - write to the $GITHUB_OUTPUT file instead.
the ::save-state workflow command was disabled on 2023-06-01 and is now ignored - write to the $GITHUB_STATE file instead.
the ::set-env and ::add-path commands were disabled on 2020-11-16 for a security advisory - write to $GITHUB_ENV or $GITHUB_PATH instead.
this action declares the node12 or node16 runtime, which no longer exists on the runner - declare using: 'node24'.
this action declares the node20 runtime. Node 24 became the runner default on 2026-06-16 and Node 20 is removed on 2026-09-23 - declare using: 'node24' (needs runner 2.327.1 or later).
this opt-out pins actions back to Node 20. It stops working on 2026-09-23 when Node 20 is removed from the runner - migrate the action to node24 instead of setting it.
this was the early opt-in to Node 24. Node 24 has been the runner default since 2026-06-16, so the variable no longer changes anything and can be deleted.
actions/create-release and actions/upload-release-asset were archived by GitHub and receive no runtime updates - use the gh CLI (gh release create) or softprops/action-gh-release.
Node 16 reached end-of-life on 2023-09-11 and Node 18 on 2025-04-30 - neither gets security patches. Build against Node 22 or 24.
